stations.title: Sunniva
stations.say: Will my changes stay this time?

stations.title: The API
stations.text: Reads the file, but changes go nowhere.

captions: At the front desk, Sunniva adds a Friday class and wants it to stay this time.
The API reads the file now, but adding, changing and removing still fail.
You write the insert, the update and the delete, and read what each one changed.
Throwing bowls is saved with its own id and is still there after a restart.
Changes outlive the server, and a change to a workshop that is gone answers 404.
